ambiguities: The cyclist's unheard remark to her companion, followed by laughter, comes right after the narrator's prolonged staring at her, which could imply mockery or exclusion of the narrator by the group; but the narrator explicitly states he did not hear what was said, so this cannot be scored as a snub with any confidence.

Bergotte is mentioned only as the source of the prestige-by-association already captured for Gilberte in the accepted annotation (E1); the passage gives him no distinct local evaluative outcome of his own, so he is not separately scored.

Much of this passage is essayistic reflection on desire, imagination, and the unknowability of others rather than a staged social scene; while the narrator dwells on his exclusion from the girls' world, this reads as generalized meditation rather than a concrete staged inclusion/exclusion event, so le narrateur is not scored as a participant here.
